description: This PHP script handles WiFi spectrum analysis and neighboring WiFi diagnostics, including functions for translating MAC addresses, rearranging SDTR values, retrieving WiFi diagnostic results, and controlling diagnostic states.

methods.name: mac_translate
methods.description: Converts a MAC address string to uppercase and formats it with colons if not already formatted.

methods.name: rearrange_SDTR
methods.description: Rearranges SDTR string by inserting a hyphen after every third comma chunk.

methods.name: get_results
methods.description: Retrieves neighboring WiFi diagnostic results, processes BSSID MAC addresses, and returns the data or progress status.
